e22_esb_population: The tail-silence-2s probe media variant of E22-DEV-ESB-1500-V1: the SAME 1,500 published ESB segments of this study's own registered Earnings-22 DEV subset10 (150 from each of the ten calls) that the sealed 2026-09-05 arm A read, re-encoded by one deterministic rule from the SEALED dev-v1 WAV bytes by the model-free row SAEA-SN-MF-E22-DEV1500-ENCODING-VARIANTS-V1. 12948.983 s = 3.5969 h for one pass, 178282 audio tokens. Preregistration: docs/readiness/2026-09-07-e22-dev-encoding-probes-v1-preregistration.md.
e22_esb_variant_factor: the acoustic tail: exactly 2.0 s of digital silence appended to every clip, so the speech offset is followed by the clamp-floor mel features a stop produces instead of being followed immediately by the encoder's zero-pad block. The 2026-09-07 encoding audit measured that appended digital silence lands on the clamp floor (median -0.7152 normalized) on these exact clips, while the pad the encoder inserts is 0.0.
e22_esb_identity_hash_convention: e22_esb_split_identity_hash is data.splits.split_identity_hash(prefixed('earnings22-original', sample_ids)) over earnings22-original/<call>-<segment>@ts2, the value core.flight.FlightRuntime.preflight computes at flight time and the value an exposure row must carry. It DIFFERS from the dev-v1 population's c626e62f... by construction: a variant clip never shares an identifier with its dev-v1 twin, so no receipt, reference lookup or paired join can silently mix the two populations.
e22_esb_media_root: The 1,500 variant WAVs live under $SPEECHRL_DATA_DIR/derived/e22-esb-utterances/dev1500-tail2s-v1 and never enter Git (414433456 bytes). They are deterministic transformations of the sealed dev-v1 bytes, each source file re-hashed against the committed D1 media supplement before it was read; no parent MP3 was opened and no decoder ran, so librosa never runs and the pinned absence of ffmpeg is preserved.
e22_esb_d1_media_supplement: The 1,500 @ts2 ids enter D1's identity closure through the additive media supplement named above (schema saea-d1-media-supplement-v1, the shape contracts.gate_media_identity reads); it chains to the same parent D1 identity artifact the dev-v1 and dev1500 supplements chain to, and binds to this population's own probe view through source_binding_sha256 ae747c52.
e22_esb_split_role_basis: No owner allowance is involved and none is claimed. These ten calls ARE this study's registered earnings22-original dev subset10 (docs/receipts/splits.json, split 'dev', count 10, identity 89b178d6b1ef46d9ca820ae54349e3d2099c60cde6d6b753ef9f66137c310028), which is the split this study may optimize on, and every published segment here was already read by the sealed 2026-09-05 arms. No confirmatory call is named, loaded, decoded, scored or read by this fragment or by any run that composes it, and the six calibration-exposed ESB test calls stay a separate population with a separate roster, a separate reference layer and a separate derived media root.
e22_esb_reference_boundary: The 'sentence' column is gold and NEVER enters the request path. The roster receipt this fragment names carries identifiers, media paths, measured media identity and segment spans only. References live in the SAME hash-pinned dev10 derived layer the sealed dev arms were scored against, unedited, and the published segment key is recovered by splitting the sample id on '@' -- reproduction.esb_reference performs that split, so a variant row scores against its own published sentence and against nothing else.
e22_esb_window_fit: The longest utterance is 34.880000 s. On the exact front-end rule the 2026-09-07 encoding audit derived and proved against 6,038 sealed prompt_tokens -- 13 tokens per 100 mel frames, n_eff = n_samples // 160 + 1 -- that is 455 speech tokens. Worst required = 455 speech + the 49-token arm A text envelope the same audit measured + 1024 completion + 2 special = about 1530, against the 5,120-token slot the -c 40960 -np 8 geometry gives: a ratio of 3.35x on this repository's own slot_tokens >= 2 x worst rule.
